p7_001: [[0|Air source heat pump]] absorbs free energy from the air, and then transports the energy to cold water through the compressor doing work to heat large amounts of energy efficient hot water, thus realising the needs of central heating and domestic hot water.
p7_002: This commercial heat pump is designed with [[0|two independent refrigerant systems]], both of which have the [[0|same configuration]]. A complete refrigeration cycle system consists of four major parts: [[1|Compressor, Evaporator,]] [[1|Condenser and Throttle device]].
p7_003: [[0|* Evaporator:]]low temperature, low pressure refrigerant go through evaporator, vaporizes into low-temperature and low-pressure steam;
p7_004: [[0|* Compressor:]] compresses the refrigerant steam into high-temp high-pressure gas, which is discharged into the condenser.
p7_005: [[0|* Condenser:]] refrigerant release heat energy to heat exchanger, and it returns from gas status to liquid status.The heat energy is absorbed by water, then the hot water is sent to indoor user’s end through the water pressure.
p7_006: [[0|* EEV:]] at last the refrigerant go through the electronic expansion valve, where its pressure is reduced, and then continues to the evaporator.

p9_001: [[0|The Full DC inverter technology makes the unit can intelligently adjust the operating frequency and control the water]] [[0|temperature to keep the room at a constant-temps.]] [[0|Under low ambient temperature, Power World's R290 FULL DC INVERTER heat pump can operate stably and efficien]]tly in extremely cold regions of -25[[1|°]]C without EVI technology. Its COP is as high as 5.0 and energy efficiency class reaches A+++(35℃) and outputting 78[[1|°]]C hot water to ensure the heating and cooling of the house need. It can save up to 50% energy electricity compared to ON-OFF units and up to 75% energy compared to traditional boiler electric heat pumps.
p10_001: Power World’s Heat Pumps support connect smart grid and photovoltaic system to store energy. When connecting the SG and EVU signal, the heat pump will run in hot water mode priority to heat the water, then, according to peak electricity consumption or other conditions, provide hot water to users. It can store energy well, monitor energy use and allocate it reasonably, and reduce energy consumption.
p11_001: (1) When SG signal is ON, and EVU signal is ON, the hot water mode is set to be valid, heat pump will operate hot water mode priority and the hot water mode setting temp will be changed to 70℃. When THWt < 69℃, the TBH is on; When THWt ≥ 70℃, the TBH is off. (2) When SG signal is OFF, and EVU signal is ON, and the hot water mode is set to be valid, heat pump will operate hot water mode priority. When THWt< TWHTs-2, the TBH is on; When THWt ≥ THWTs+3℃, the TBH is off. (3) When SG signal is ON, and EVU signal is OFF, the unit operates normally according to actual needs. (4) When SG signal is OFF, and EVU signal is OFF, the unit will not operate hot water mode priority automatically, and the TBH is invalid, disinfect function is invalid. Heat pump forced operation energy-saving mode, and the max running time for cooling/heating is ‘Energy-saving operating time’, then unit will be off.

p12_001: The heat pump is built in a refrigerant leakage sensor from factory,  it’s used to detect and monitor the leakage of R290 refrigerant, ensuring the safety and efficiency of the system. When the [[0|leakage concentration exceeds 15% LFL]], the system will sound an alarm and display[[0|fault code 209]], reminding users to handle it in a timely manner to ensure safe use. [[0|The compressor and all electric heating will stop, and the fan is running at the lowest speed.]]
p12_002: [[0|Solution:]] Power off the unit immediately, keep good ventilate, check the refrigerant leakage point of the unit, and repair it. (Professional installation personnel are required to operate it)
